prompt: Milo found a silver key beneath the old oak tree. He wondered which door it could open, so he asked his friend Lina to help.
A small blue bird landed on the windowsill during the rain. Nora offered it a dry towel and waited quietly for the clouds to pass.
When the village clock stopped at midnight, everyone blamed the wind. Tomas climbed the tower and discovered a tiny mouse beside the gears.
Grandma planted three seeds in a clay pot and told Sami to be patient. Each morning he watered the soil and watched for a green leaf.
The little fox carried a red apple through the forest, looking for someone to share it with. Near the stream, she heard a soft laugh.
A paper boat sailed along the gutter after the storm. Eli followed it down the street, hoping it would reach the garden pond safely.
At the edge of the meadow, a wooden sign pointed toward a place called Sunny Hill. Priya packed a snack and invited her brother along.
The baker noticed a golden feather beside the flour sack. He placed it on the counter and wondered which visitor had left it there.
